validity.researcher_notes: MAJOR SPEC DISCREPANCY. The sheet's recorded LengthKnown=21.60 mi is sourced (per EIA) to this project, but FERC's own certificate order for CP20-503 -- read and pdftotext-extracted in full (1085 lines) -- gives a complete, itemized 'Specifically, Northern proposes to:' facilities list totaling only: (1) 'an approximately 0.80-mile-long extension of its 24-inch-diameter Willmar D branch line' (Dakota/Scott Counties); (2) 'an approximately 0.63-mile-long, 24-inch-diameter pipeline loop of its Carlton interconnect branch line' (Carlton County); (3) 'replace an existing 0.08-mile-long, 8-inch-diameter branch line with a 12-inch-diameter pipeline of the same length' (Morrison County, Viking interconnect) -- 0.80+0.63+0.08 = 1.51 mi of new/replaced pipe, plus two compressor-station additions (no mileage). A grep of the full order text for every occurrence of 'mile' found only these three bullets plus one unrelated reference to Northern's system-wide '14,700-mile pipeline system' -- there is no other mileage figure anywhere in the order. Footnote 14 separately itemizes short abandoned segments (422 ft Viking branch + 10-20 ft Carlton takeoff + 140 ft Carlton CS tie-in + 60 ft Hinckley CS B-line + 150 ft Pierz CS piping = approx. 782-792 ft, approx. 0.15 mi) -- even combined with the 1.51 mi of new/replaced pipe, total facilities are nowhere close to 21.6 mi. Cross-checked against sources/eia_pipeline_projects/data/eia_projects_long.csv: the 21.6 mi figure has been CONSTANT across all 22 tracked EIA releases from 2020-01 ('Pre-applied', last_updated 2019-12-02 -- predating the July 31, 2020 application itself) straight through 2026-08 ('Completed') -- strongly suggesting 21.6 mi is either a persistent EIA data-entry artifact or traces to a broader pre-filing (PF20-1) scope never carried into the actual certificated CP20-503 project. This is a single strong primary-source origin (the FERC order) disagreeing with the sheet's existing single-origin (EIA) figure, so per the tier-discipline/disagreement rule this fill is staged at medium/independent:false despite being a direct primary-source read, rather than promoted to high. Recommend a human verify against the original PF20-1 pre-filing application exhibits (not accessed in this pass) or a post-completion as-built/compliance filing before applying the correction live.
